hook_text: A car lane and a bus lane, side by side. Which one moves more people?
clip_script: The car lane carries about 1 800 cars an hour, with about 1.2 people each: 2 160 people. The bus lane carries 60 buses an hour, 80 passengers each: 4 800 people. More than twice as many, in the same space. That is why Rea Vaya, MyCiTi and A Re Yeng run in their own lanes. Add subsidies for cheaper fares, cycle lanes, park and ride at Gautrain stations and car-free streets, and a city starts to move people, not just cars.
visual_style: A whiteboard road split into a crowded car lane and a fast bus lane, with people counters ticking up beside each.
pacing: Builds from the lane comparison to the full toolkit.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master public transport strategies.
